title: Eykon walkthrough flow data, schema version 1
description: Two file kinds share these definitions: one stage file per stage (flow/stages/<stage-id>.json) and one index (flow/index.json). Paths in 'doc' and 'stage_files' are relative to docs/walkthrough/; paths in 'files' are repo-relative. A field that does not apply holds 'n/a: <why>', never an empty string. validate_flow.py enforces the 'required' lists and the non-empty rule.

node_id.description: A stage id (s04-scene) or stage id + '/' + local id (s04-scene/model-yolox-tiny). Globally unique.

type.description: What kind of thing: 'JPEG files + frames rows', 'float32 vector'.

shape.description: Size, count, dimensions, units: '512', 'one row per kept frame', '≤ 640 px longer side'.

format.description: Encoding / dtype / table and columns: 'float32 little-endian BLOB in image_vec.embedding'.

example.description: A concrete value taken from code, tests, golden files or docs/results. Say where it comes from.

name.description: Model or algorithm name with variant, or what the file does.

params.description: Key parameter name -> value with its source, e.g. {"HASH_MAX": "6 bits (VideoDedup.kt:23)"}. May be empty when there are none.

summary.description: The decision this node embodies, in one or two sentences.

source.description: DOCUMENTED: the doc/comment/commit that says why. INFERRED: the code evidence. UNKNOWN: the open-question id (Q-s04-2).

label.description: Short, shown on the node (≤ 32 characters is best).

stage.description: Parent stage id. For a type 'stage' node, its own id.

key.description: Optional. Groups instances of the same model/algorithm across stages, e.g. 'mobileclip-s2-image'.

files.description: Repo-relative paths. External and data-store nodes list the file that defines or reads them.

refs.description: Optional. 'path:line-line' pointers to the exact code.

performance.description: Complexity, timings (only measured ones, with their docs/results file), batching, caching, threads, memory. 'n/a: <why>' when nothing applies.

doc.description: Link to the matching section, e.g. 'stages/s04-scene.md#4-models-and-algorithms-used'. The anchor must exist (slug rule in validate_flow.py).

entry.description: Stage nodes only: where data enters the stage.

exit.description: Stage nodes only: where data leaves the stage.

file.description: Index stage entries only: the stage file.

to.description: May be a node of another stage (cross-stage edges live in the stage that produces the data).

label.description: Short text shown on the edge: what is passed.

stage.description: type 'stage', with platform, entry and exit.

steps.description: In order. Consecutive steps must be joined by an edge, or lie in two stages joined by an index edge.

stages.description: The type 'stage' nodes, copied from the stage files, each with 'file'.
